lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਛਪੈ ਕਿਉ ਛਪਿਆ ਏਕੀ ਏਕੀ ਵੰਡਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak chhapai kiu chhapiaa ekee ekee va(n)d deeaa ||4||7||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, by hiding, how can the Lord be hidden? He has given each their share, one by one. ||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਬੇਲਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam karatoot bel bisathaaree raam naam phal hooaa ||
lines.translation: The vine of good actions and character has spread out, and it bears the fruit of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਕੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tis roop na rekh anaahad vaajai sabad nira(n)jan keeaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Name has no form or outline; it vibrates with the unstruck Sound Current; through the Word of the Shabad, the Immaculate Lord is revealed. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਵਖਿਆਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kare vakhiaan jaanai je koee ||
lines.translation: One can speak on this only when he knows it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit peevai soee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He alone drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਪੀਆ ਸੇ ਮਸਤ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਤੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਫਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinh peeaa se masat bhae hai toote ba(n)dhan phaahe ||
lines.translation: Those who drink it in are enraptured; their bonds and shackles are cut away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਛੋਡੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲਾਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jotee jot samaanee bheetar taa chhode maaiaa ke laahe ||2||
lines.translation: When one's light blends into the Divine Light, then the desire for Maya is ended. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab jot roop teraa dekhiaa sagal bhavan teree maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Among all lights, I behold Your Form; all the worlds are Your Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਰੈ ਰੂਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: raarai roop niraalam baithaa nadar kare vich chhaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Among the tumults and forms, He sits in serene detachment; He bestows His Glance of Grace upon those who are engrossed in the illusion. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੀਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: beenaa sabad vajaavai jogee darasan roop apaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Yogi who plays on the instrument of the Shabad gains the Blessed Vision of the Infinitely Beautiful Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: sabad anaahad so sahu raataa naanak kahai vichaaraa ||4||8||
lines.translation: He, the Lord, is immersed in the Unstruck Shabad of the Word, says Nanak, the humble and meek. ||4||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਾ ਕੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai gun galaa ke sir bhaar ||
lines.translation: My virtue is that I carry the load of my words upon my head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਗਲਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: galee galaa sirajanahaar ||
lines.translation: The real words are the Words of the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਹਸਣਾ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaanaa peenaa hasanaa baad ||
lines.translation: How useless are eating, drinking and laughing,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਯਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag ridai na aavahi yaad ||1||
lines.translation: if the Lord is not cherished in the heart! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਕੇਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau paravaah kehee kiaa keejai ||
lines.translation: Why should someone care for anything else,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੀਜੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam kichh leejee leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: if throughout his life, he gathers in that which is truly worth gathering? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਮਤਾਗਲੁ ਮਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kee mat mataagal mataa ||
lines.translation: The intellect of the mind is like a drunken elephant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਖਤੋ ਖਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh boleeai sabh khato khataa ||
lines.translation: Whatever one utters is totally false, the most false of the false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa muhu lai keechai aradaas ||
lines.translation: So what face should we put on to offer our prayer,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਖੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: paap pu(n)n dui saakhee paas ||2||
lines.translation: when both virtue and vice are close at hand as witnesses? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa too(n) karahi taisaa ko hoi ||
lines.translation: As You make us, so we become.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin doojaa naahee koi ||
lines.translation: Without You, there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਹੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jehee too(n) mat dehi tehee ko paavai ||
lines.translation: As is the understanding which You bestow, so do we receive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aape bhaavai tivai chalaavai ||3||
lines.translation: As it pleases Your Will, so do You lead us. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਪਰੀਆ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag ratan pareeaa paravaar ||
lines.translation: The divine crystalline harmonies, their consorts, and their celestial families

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis vich upajai a(n)mrit saar ||
lines.translation: from them, the essence of Ambrosial Nectar is produced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak karate kaa ihu dhan maal ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, this is the wealth and property of the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: je ko boojhai ehu beechaar ||4||9||
lines.translation: If only this essential reality were understood! ||4||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa apanai ghar aaiaa taa mil sakheeaa kaaj rachaaiaa ||
lines.translation: When by His Grace He came to my home, then my companions met together to celebrate my marriage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਹੁ ਵੀਆਹਣ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khel dekh man anad bhaiaa sahu veeaahan aaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Beholding this play, my mind became blissful; my Husband Lord has come to marry me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavahu gaavahu kaamanee bibek beechaar ||
lines.translation: So sing - yes, sing the songs of wisdom and reflection, O brides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamarai ghar aaiaa jagajeevan bhataar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My spouse, the Life of the world, has come into my home. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਮਰਾ ਵੀਆਹੁ ਜਿ ਹੋਆ ਜਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guroo duaarai hamaraa veeaahu j hoaa jaa(n) sahu miliaa taa(n) jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: When I was married within the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, I met my Husband Lord, and I came to know Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਹੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tihu lokaa mahi sabad raviaa hai aap gaiaa man maaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Word of His Shabad is pervading the three worlds; when my ego was quieted, my mind became happy. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਹੋਰਨਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa kaaraj aap savaare horan kaaraj na hoee ||
lines.translation: He Himself arranges His own affairs; His affairs cannot be arranged by anyone else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jit kaaraj sat sa(n)tokh daiaa dharam hai guramukh boojhai koee ||3||
lines.translation: By the affair of this marriage, truth, contentment, mercy and faith are produced; but how rare is that Gurmukh who understands it! ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak sabhanaa kaa pir eko soi ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, that Lord alone is the Husband of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar kare saa sohaagan hoi ||4||10||
lines.translation: She, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, becomes the happy soul-bride. ||4||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਬਨੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: grihu ban samasar sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: Home and forest are the same, for one who dwells in the balance of intuitive peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਤੁ ਭਈ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਠਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: duramat gat bhaee keerat thaai ||
lines.translation: His evil-mindedness departs, and the Praises of God take its place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਪਉੜੀ ਸਾਚਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਂਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach pauRee saachau mukh naa(n)u ||
lines.translation: To chant the True Name with one's mouth is the true ladder.
